statusText: Tail eases to 11%. Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ Dec26 has fully retraced the 31,349.50 overnight low and trades 31,409.75, mid-band and back above its prior close, while Stress rises to 53% on AI-linked tech debt headlines, Brent near $102.6 and a 10-year that reached a 24-year high of 5.36% on Oct 7.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON with Tail at 11%, well below the 25% blocking threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers 13:30Z-15:00Z around the US cash open, where conditional Tail reaches its 21% WATCH peak. Jobless claims at 12:30Z and the 17:00Z 30-year Treasury auction are the session's other checkpoints, the auction more pointed than usual given long-end stress.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures retrace their overnight low as AI-linked tech debt and a 24-year-high long end lift background stress
body: The sixth Globex hour of the Oct 7-8 session has resolved the mild downward tilt flagged an hour earlier. NQ Dec26 trades 31,409.75 at 05:16Z, +7.50 or +0.02% against a 31,402.25 prior close, inside an unchanged band of 31,349.50-31,466.00. The 31,349.50 low printed in the previous hour has been fully retraced: NQ now sits about 60 points above it and 56 below the session high, essentially mid-band. The band is still only 116.5 points, or 0.37%, wide, and the Oct 7 cash session behaved the same way, fully retracing a dip to 30,904.46 before the Nasdaq-100 closed 31,160.08, -0.21%, ten points below its 31,170.12 high. Repeated extension after failed retracements is the pathological structure the Tail score is built to detect, and the observed path is its opposite, so Tail eases to 11%. Asian cash confirms rather than contradicts this. The Nikkei 225 trades 69,576.12, -0.66%, having recovered 382 points from a 69,194.12 low; Associated Press reporting timed at 05:17Z still had it at 69,438.77, -0.9%, so the recovery is live. Reuters recorded the Kospi down 2.1% early, and AP later put it 0.8% lower at 6,750.25. The pressure sits in the macro and credit background, which is where Stress rises to 53%. A genuinely new theme is AI-linked technology debt: Broadcom has held early talks on roughly $30bn of financing for OpenAI chip purchases, following a reported $60bn Broadcom debt package for an Anthropic build-out with a $42bn senior-secured tranche and an $18bn Blackstone-led junior tranche, while SpaceX is reported to be raising about $40bn to buy Nvidia chips and its credit-default-swap prices have hit record highs. That is a credit-channel risk to megacap tech, and it currently reduces conviction rather than creating one-way index structure. Rates remain the dominant constraint: the 10-year reached 5.36% on Oct 7, its highest since 2002, before a strong 10-year auction pulled it back toward 5.28-5.31, and H.15 for Oct 6 puts the 2-year at 4.79%, the 10-year at 5.27% and the 30-year at 5.64%. The September FOMC minutes record most participants seeing another increase as likely by year end from the current 3.75-4.00%, with implied odds near 19% for the coming meeting and about 80% for December. Crude has extended: Brent is near $102.6, up about 2.4%, after a report that the White House asked the Pentagon to draw up Iran strike options and amid continuing Gulf shipping attacks, with Tropical Storm Isaias shutting in more than 510,000 barrels per day in the Gulf of Mexico. The dollar index is near an 18-month high at 102.22 and the euro near 17-month lows on French fiscal concern. VIX closed Oct 7 at 15.08, giving no evidence of a volatility regime shift. Under the risk contract this stack of hawkish rates, firm crude, tech credit stress and geopolitical supply risk raises Stress and leaves Tail low, because none of it is observed persistent one-way NQ structure. Shared Finviz context was read and found stale, dated 2026-09-29 with partial collection status, so it was excluded and the assessment rests on independent primary-source research.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail ran 10-14% through the Asian and European hours of Oct 7, rose into a 20-23% WATCH band between 11:00Z and 15:00Z as a trend-down phase developed into the US cash open, then decayed steadily once the dip to 30,904.46 was fully retraced into the close. Every Globex hour from 16:00Z onward held 10-18% and no WATCH print has occurred since 15:00Z. Stress climbed from 47% to 51% across the window as long-end yields and crude firmed, and Confidence held 87-89% throughout.
outlookSummary: Base case is continued two-way NQ rotation while AI-linked technology debt stress, a 10-year that reached a 24-year high of 5.36%, Brent near $102.6 and a dollar index at an 18-month high remain the dominant background conflict. Conditional Tail holds 11% through the remaining Asian hours, firms to 12-15% across the European session and the 08:30Z Waller speech, reaches 18% in the hour containing the 12:30Z jobless claims release and a 21% WATCH peak in the hour containing the 13:30Z US cash open, eases to 17-18% through the US morning, lifts to 19% for the 17:00Z 30-year auction and 17:40Z Musalem speech, then decays to 11-16% across the Globex and Asian hours into the Oct 9 European pre-open. Confidence declines from 88% to 76% with forecast distance only.
